title: Chronicle of the Hand
place: The Tower of the Hand, the Red Keep, King's Landing
description: You reached King's Landing as Hand of the King in 298 AC, after King Robert rode to Winterfell to ask it of you. Jon Arryn, your boyhood guardian and the last Hand, is dead.

sources.title: A Song of Ice and Fire
World of A Song of Ice and Fire

grounding: Grounded in George R. R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire book canon: the small council, the great houses and the events of A Game of Thrones, 298 AC.

fall.what: After King Robert's death, Eddard Stark was betrayed by Littlefinger and the City Watch, arrested for treason, and beheaded on King Joffrey's order.

factions.name: King Robert I Baratheon
factions.ideology: The King on the Iron Throne. He wants his Hand to rule, pay for feasts and kill the last Targaryens.

face.name: Robert Baratheon
face.role: King of the Andals, the Rhoynar and the First Men, the Red Keep

glance.strike: King Robert takes back the Hand's chain and sends Lord Eddard home to Winterfell.

factions.name: Queen Cersei Lannister and House Lannister
factions.ideology: The queen and her father's house, richest in the realm. They want Joffrey's succession safe and the Hand's inquiry stopped.

glance.strike: The queen sets Lannister swords and the Kingsguard to seize the Hand and his daughters.

factions.name: House Stark
factions.ideology: The Lord of Winterfell's own house and northern bannermen. They want justice for Bran and the Hand's daughters kept safe.

face.name: Robb Stark
face.role: Heir to Winterfell, holding the North in his father's absence

glance.strike: Robb Stark keeps the northern bannermen at home and sends no swords south.

factions.name: Petyr Baelish and the City Watch
factions.ideology: The Master of Coin and the gold cloaks he pays. He wants office, lands and a court in turmoil.

face.name: Petyr Baelish
face.role: Master of Coin, the small council, King's Landing

glance.strike: Littlefinger turns the gold cloaks of the City Watch against the Hand at the hour of need.

factions.name: Varys
factions.ideology: The eunuch spymaster of the small council. He wants war between Stark and Lannister delayed and his informers left alone.

face.name: Varys
face.role: Master of Whisperers, the small council, King's Landing

glance.strike: Varys carries the Hand's secrets to the queen, and his little birds stop whispering to the Tower of the Hand.

factions.name: Stannis Baratheon
factions.ideology: The King's stern middle brother, withdrawn to his island seat. He wants to be named Robert's lawful heir.

face.name: Stannis Baratheon
face.role: Lord of Dragonstone and master of ships

glance.strike: Stannis keeps the royal fleet at Dragonstone and refuses the Crown his ships and swords.

blocs.name: Smallfolk of King's Landing
blocs.description: Pot-shop keepers, porters and beggars of Flea Bottom and the lanes below the Red Keep, who eat what the Crown's gold buys.

blocs.name: Crofters of the North
blocs.description: Herders and farmers under Winterfell who send their sons when the bannermen are called and store grain before every winter.

blocs.name: Farmers of the Riverlands
blocs.description: Villagers along the rivers whose fields and holdfasts lie open to raiders from the west.

blocs.name: Merchants and craftsmen
blocs.description: Traders, smiths and chandlers of the port towns who lend to lords, sell to tourneys and pay the Crown's tolls.

blocs.name: Septons and the faithful
blocs.description: The Faith's septons and the devout smallfolk of the south, who judge a Hand by his justice and his piety.

patrons.name: Goldsmiths and moneylenders of King's Landing
Brothel keepers of the Street of Silk

members.name: Eddard Pycelle
members.bio: Born near Highgarden, Eddard Pycelle kept accounts for a wool factor before Robert raised him. He wants the Crown's debts paid without breaking the king's feasts.
members.tell: He counts cupbearers before he speaks.

glance.strike: He withholds the Crown's ledgers and backs Robert's next Hand.

members.name: Pycelle
members.bio: Pycelle was born at Castamere and studied at the Citadel before becoming Grand Maester. He wants the queen's line protected and the court's secrets preserved.
members.tell: He strokes his chain when a dangerous name is spoken.

glance.strike: He sends a raven to Cersei and gives the council a safer account.

members.name: Renly Stark
members.bio: Renly Stark grew up at Storm's End and rode in Robert's rebellion before taking court office. He wants northern honour joined to royal power.
members.tell: He touches the hilt of his sword whenever a Lannister enters.

glance.strike: He calls northern banners and closes the Red Keep gates to the queen.

members.name: Barristan Selmy
members.bio: Barristan Selmy was born at Harvest Hall and won his spurs in the Kingswood. He wants the Kingsguard kept above faction and rich men.
members.tell: He removes his gloves before every council vote.

glance.strike: He lays down his white cloak and tells the court why.

members.name: Arys Oakheart
members.bio: Arys Oakheart was born at Old Oak and trained in the Reach household guard. He wants the Kingsguard to protect the royal children from court quarrels.
members.tell: He checks the chamber door after each report.

glance.strike: He escorts the children from the Red Keep and swears against the ruler.

members.name: Meryn Trant
members.bio: Meryn Trant came from a minor Crownlands house and entered Robert's household guard after the rebellion. He wants the king's commands obeyed without debate.
members.tell: He taps his mailed thumb against his pommel.

glance.strike: He takes the gold cloaks to Robert and demands the Hand's arrest.

members.name: Boros Blount
members.bio: Boros Blount was born in the Stormlands and guarded a lord's grain trains before joining the Kingsguard. He wants regular pay and a quiet royal household.
members.tell: He asks first who will pay for any order.

glance.strike: He abandons the council room and reports its orders to the king.

members.name: Jaime Stark
members.bio: Jaime Stark was born at Lannisport and captained a merchant's guards before entering court politics. He wants a settlement that keeps Lannister gold and royal law together.
members.tell: He rolls a gold coin across his knuckles during disputes.

glance.strike: He quits the council and carries the queen's case to Tywin.

members.name: Tyrion Lannister
members.bio: Tyrion Lannister was born at Casterly Rock and studied histories before serving at court. He wants room for wit, a paid treasury and no war over Bran's fall.
members.tell: He drinks before answering a question meant to trap him.

glance.strike: He buys witnesses and turns the council's own secrets against the ruler.

members.name: Kevan Lannister
members.bio: Kevan Lannister was raised at Casterly Rock and led levies during Robert's rebellion. He wants Tywin's credit protected and the realm kept from civil war.
members.tell: He folds his hands only after every lord has been named.

glance.strike: He leaves for the west and gathers Lannister banners.

members.name: Addam Marbrand
members.bio: Addam Marbrand came from Ashemark and escorted royal columns after the rebellion. He wants roads open, soldiers paid and the king's peace visible.
members.tell: He marks each delay with a notch in his belt leather.

glance.strike: He rides to the City Watch and orders it to hold the gates.

members.name: Lyle Crakehall
members.bio: Lyle Crakehall was born at Crakehall and managed his family's swine herds before taking a royal commission. He wants hard law against raiders and deserters.
members.tell: He cracks his knuckles when a pardon is proposed.

glance.strike: He joins the field host and refuses the ruler's seal.

members.name: Vardis Egen
members.bio: Vardis Egen was born in the Vale and kept toll roads for House Egen before entering Robert's service. He wants the king to respect lawful summonses.
members.tell: He straightens every document before signing it.

glance.strike: He carries the summons to the Eyrie and calls for a formal judgment.

members.name: Loras Tyrell
members.bio: Loras Tyrell was born at Highgarden and won tourneys before joining the court. He wants glory for the Reach and a royal purse for knights.
members.tell: He smiles whenever a purse or horse is mentioned.

glance.strike: He rides to Highgarden and asks Mace for a new alliance.

members.name: Mace Tyrell
members.bio: Mace Tyrell inherited Highgarden after Lord Wyllis lost his strength. He wants Robert's favour for his house and a marriage that lifts the Reach.
members.tell: He repeats a proposal until every lord calls it theirs.

glance.strike: He withdraws Reach grain and opens talks with Renly.

members.name: Randyll Tarly
members.bio: Randyll Tarly was born at Horn Hill and drilled levies before Robert's reign. He wants a disciplined army and punishment for men who flee it.
members.tell: He names the last man who broke ranks.

glance.strike: He takes his levies home and refuses the next royal summons.

members.name: Paxter Redwyne
members.bio: Paxter Redwyne was born on the Arbor and ran wine ships before entering council service. He wants safe seas, paid debts and royal protection for trade.
members.tell: He smells wine on a ledger before reading its figures.

glance.strike: He closes the Arbor's loans and sends Redwyne ships away from King's Landing.

members.name: Bronn
members.bio: Bronn was born in the Crownlands and sold his sword on roads from Gulltown to the Trident. He wants coin, a title and a ruler who pays on time.
members.tell: He counts the room's exits before sitting down.

glance.strike: He sells his sword to the highest lord and leaves the council by night.

members.name: Cersei Stark
members.bio: Cersei Stark was born at Casterly Rock and arranged household marriages before taking a seat. She wants Joffrey crowned and her daughters safe from northern claims.
members.tell: She touches her necklace when Robert's name is spoken.

glance.strike: She carries her case to Cersei Lannister and closes the court against the Hand.

members.name: Catelyn Stark
members.bio: Catelyn Stark was born at Riverrun and kept its household during Hoster's illness. She wants Bran's attacker tried and her daughters returned from the court.
members.tell: She folds a letter from Winterfell into her sleeve.

glance.strike: She summons Riverlands lords and names the ruler false to justice.

members.name: Selyse Florent
members.bio: Selyse Florent was born at Brightwater Keep and managed its chapel stores before court life. She wants the Faith heard and Stannis named lawful heir.
members.tell: She presses a prayer bead into her palm during arguments.

glance.strike: She sends a sealed letter to Dragonstone and denounces the court's sin.

members.name: Asha Greyjoy
members.bio: Asha Greyjoy was born at Pyke and captained a longship before Balon called her home. She wants the Iron Islands free to raid and rule their own shores.
members.tell: She laughs when a mainland lord calls himself brave.

glance.strike: She sails west and urges Balon to raise the ironborn.

members.name: Lysa Arryn
members.bio: Lysa Arryn was born at Riverrun and kept the Eyrie's household after Jon Arryn's death. She wants her son safe and the Vale closed to royal armies.
members.tell: She tears wax seals from letters before anyone can read them.

glance.strike: She seals the Bloody Gate and refuses the ruler's messengers.

members.name: Melisandre
members.bio: Melisandre came from Asshai and preached to sailors in Volantis before reaching the court. She wants Stannis crowned and the red god's enemies cast down.
members.tell: She watches the hearth instead of the speaker.

glance.strike: She leaves for Dragonstone and calls Stannis to claim the throne.

starts.premise: The King on the Iron Throne. He wants his Hand to rule, pay for feasts and kill the last Targaryens.
The queen and her father's house, richest in the realm. They want Joffrey's succession safe and the Hand's inquiry stopped.
The Lord of Winterfell's own house and northern bannermen. They want justice for Bran and the Hand's daughters kept safe.
The Master of Coin and the gold cloaks he pays. He wants office, lands and a court in turmoil.
The eunuch spymaster of the small council. He wants war between Stark and Lannister delayed and his informers left alone.
The King's stern middle brother, withdrawn to his island seat. He wants to be named Robert's lawful heir.

problems: Jon Arryn is dead, Lysa Arryn writes that he was murdered, and you do not know by whose hand.
The Crown debt passes six million gold dragons, much of it owed to Tywin Lannister and the Iron Bank of Braavos.
King Robert wants Daenerys Targaryen killed, and you have already quarrelled with him over killing a girl.
Bran Stark's fall was followed by an attempt on his life, and Lady Catelyn names Tyrion Lannister for it.
King Robert has ordered the Hand's Tourney in your honour and means to pay for it with borrowed gold.
Sansa Stark, 11, is betrothed to Joffrey Baratheon, and both your daughters live in the Red Keep beside the queen.
The smallfolk of the Riverlands want justice against raiders, and Gregor Clegane rides on Lord Tywin's word.
Viserys Targaryen seeks a Dothraki army across the Narrow Sea while winter nears and the granaries stand thin.

escalations.name: The city turns sour
escalations.headline: The talk of the city in every pot-shop and tavern now mocks the northern Hand and his cold justice.

escalations.name: The council closes ranks
escalations.headline: The small council agrees among itself before you enter, and your decrees are set aside by custom.

escalations.name: The ports go quiet
escalations.headline: Ships from the Free Cities stay away, tolls fall, and the Master of Coin reports the treasury thinner each moon.

escalations.name: A moon of whispers
escalations.headline: Tales of bastards, brothels and poison fill the Red Keep, and each one touches a councillor.

escalations.name: The King's temper
escalations.headline: King Robert drinks from midday and shouts down any councillor who brings him bad news.

escalations.name: A council divided
escalations.headline: The queen's party and the Hand's friends sit apart at the council table and will not agree on any decree.

escalations.name: Every lord his price
escalations.headline: Lords who once gave their voice for a kind word now ask for keeps, wardships and gold dragons.

escalations.name: Wavering bannermen
escalations.headline: Northern lords at Winterfell ask why their liege lord serves a southern king who will not guard his children.

escalations.name: The treasury runs dry
escalations.headline: The Master of Coin says the Crown cannot pay for the Hand's Tourney without new borrowing.

escalations.name: The King's justice fails
escalations.headline: Judges and castellans loyal to Casterly Rock set aside the Hand's writs against Lannister men.

escalations.name: The lion rises
escalations.headline: House Lannister gains places on the council and in the Kingsguard while the Hand's friends lose theirs.

escalations.name: The smallfolk shrug
escalations.headline: The smallfolk no longer come to hear the Hand's proclamations, and the smallfolk's love cools to indifference.

escalations.name: Sworn men leave
escalations.headline: Household knights and gold cloaks who swore to the Hand take coin from the queen and slip away.

escalations.name: The queen speaks openly
escalations.headline: Queen Cersei Lannister names the Hand an enemy of her son before the whole court.

escalations.name: A weary realm
escalations.headline: Lords tire of summons, levies and inquiries, and answer each new decree with delay.

escalations.name: Little birds
escalations.headline: What is said in the Tower of the Hand at night is known in the queen's chambers by morning.

escalations.name: Fire in the Riverlands
escalations.headline: Gregor Clegane burns villages in the Riverlands on Lord Tywin's word, and the river lords call for war.

escalations.name: Winter's first hunger
escalations.headline: The maesters report shortened days, and grain prices in King's Landing double before the harvest is stored.

escalations.name: The heir in question
escalations.headline: Word spreads that Joffrey Baratheon is no son of the King, and Stannis Baratheon's name is spoken in the council.

escalations.name: Gold from across the Narrow Sea
escalations.headline: The Iron Bank presses for payment while Viserys Targaryen seeks a Dothraki army in the Free Cities.

test.name: The King's judgement
test.win: You still wear the Hand's chain at the moon's turn in 299 AC, with the King's favour and enough of the realm behind you to keep it.
test.lose: The King, the queen's party or the lords of the realm turn from you, and the chain passes to another Hand.

pork.label: Crown gold for a keep
pork.text: You pay from the treasury for a lord's walls, roads or granaries, and he sends his support to the Tower of the Hand.

favor.label: A debt of favour
favor.text: You grant a lord a place, a wardship or a match now, and he owes you his voice in council when you call it in.

threat.label: A name in the file
threat.text: You let a lord know that his secrets sit in the Whisperer's file and will reach the King if he crosses you.

ruler.role: Hand of the King, chair of the small council in the Tower of the Hand, the Red Keep
ruler.removedBy: King Robert can dismiss you at will, and if he dies, a regent or the new king can strip you of the Hand of the King and arrest you for treason.

Gifts from lords who seek the Hand's ear
spend: Guarding Sansa Stark and Arya Stark in the Red Keep

briefing.situation: You reached King's Landing as Hand of the King in 298 AC, after King Robert rode to Winterfell to ask it of you. Jon Arryn, your boyhood guardian and the last Hand, is dead. His widow Lysa writes that he was murdered. At your first small council, Petyr Baelish told you the Crown debt passes six million gold dragons. Bran Stark's fall still hangs over your house. You want the truth about Jon Arryn, your daughters kept safe and the realm's accounts in order.
briefing.room: King Robert can dismiss you at will and set aside any decree he dislikes. Queen Cersei Lannister and House Lannister want you gone, and Tywin Lannister holds much of the Crown debt. Petyr Baelish keeps the purse and pays the City Watch. Varys hears everything and says little. Stannis Baratheon sits silent on Dragonstone. The Iron Bank of Braavos judges you by what the Crown repays. If the King dies, whoever takes the regency can have you arrested for treason.
briefing.you: You chair the small council, seal decrees in the King's name, and may sit the Iron Throne when he wills it. Your house brings the North's bannermen, and your name for honour is known across the Seven Kingdoms. King Robert's support stands at 68 of 100. The queen's stands at 32 of 100. The King's judgement asks one thing each moon: whether you can rule for a king who will not rule, and keep his friendship and your head.
